name: Windsurf
verdict: Windsurf no longer sells a standalone plan. Its pricing page redirects to Devin.
cons: There is no Windsurf checkout of its own
pricingNote: Windsurf no longer sells standalone. On 2026-10-14, windsurf.com/pricing returned HTTP 308 with Location https://devin.ai/pricing, and windsurf.com returned HTTP 308 to https://devin.ai/desktop. Devin's prices are not repeated here.
